# Package Exposome Version 0.90

## Overview

*Exposome* package provides an interface to fit univarate regression models for exposome-wide and metabolite-wide association studies. It lets you easily identify and remove features below a prespecified detection rate and performs univariate regression across all the specified columns. After performing univariate regression, 

The formula interface is very similar to glm, allowing you to easily define the linear regression models of interest.
